pages.text: The $(item)Meteorite Skyseed$() grows an ordinary overworld island — with a $(bold)meteor blasted into it$(). Its recipe is steep: the $(item)certus$() you've mined, $(item)IE steel$(), and a $(item)Create precision mechanism$().
Everything's in hand — here's how it goes together.

$(bold)The crater$()$(br)At the island's heart, an impact crater of $(item)obsidian$() and scorched glass rings a $(item)sky-stone globe$() — the meteoric rock an $(item)ME Controller$() is built from. Mine it out; sky stone falls nowhere else.

$(bold)The core$()$(br)Dig to the globe's centre and you'll strike a $(item)Meteorite Core$(). Break it for $(bold)one inscriber press$() — a random one of the four. The bigger meteors give more per throw, but any press you're missing is only ever a small island away.
